evals.prompt: 帮我找一下这篇论文的官方代码仓库，论文在 ~/docs/papers/iclr2020-geom-gcn-pei/
evals.expected_output: Discover the official Geom-GCN repository, verify it, and clone it to repo/.
expectations: The skill extracts code links from paper.md and PDF metadata
The skill searches GitHub if no explicit link is found in the paper
Candidates are verified against DOI citation, author match, and method name criteria
The selected repository is cloned to repo/ when confidence is high or medium
repo_search section is written to metadata.yaml with selected and candidates

evals.prompt: 这篇论文可能没有公开代码，但帮我找找有没有类似的实现
evals.expected_output: Search for reimplementation repositories and record findings even if no official repo exists.
expectations: The skill searches GitHub for the method name and paper title
Candidates are evaluated with lower confidence levels (low/medium)
repo_search section is written to metadata.yaml even when no high-confidence repo is found
The selected field is null or has low confidence, but candidates list is populated
The skill does not fail or error when no official repo is found

evals.prompt: 帮我看看 ~/docs/papers/attention2017-transformer-vaswani/ 的代码在哪，不要 clone
evals.expected_output: Find the official repository URL without cloning it.
expectations: The skill finds the TensorFlow official implementation or similar
The repo URL is recorded in metadata.yaml repo_search.selected
No git clone is performed (--no-clone or similar behavior)
The cloned_to field is absent or null in the output
